description: Founded in 1892, Assurant provides protection services to connected devices, homes, and automobiles around the world, and operates in two segments: global lifestyle and global housing. Formerly known as Fortis, Assurant services over 325 million customers around the globe.

title: Assurant

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say: 

"At Assurant, employees are truly given opportunities to grow their careers. The company offers tuition reimbursement, mentoring programs, and ongoing support to help you build skills you might not otherwise have access to. Leadership actively encourages professional development, and my manager regularly checks in to ask how she can support my career goals so I can continue advancing within the company. I enjoy working here so much that I can genuinely see myself retiring from this organization. The people are consistently supportive, easy to work with, and always willing to help."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: The New York-headquartered insurer offers a wide range of products, including extended service protection on electronic devices and appliances, homeowners and flood insurance, renters insurance, and pre-funded funeral insurance. Over the past 10 years, it has produced an average return to shareholders of some 16% per year.
